name: Romania
description: Romania from Dacia and Roman rule to Wallachia and Moldavia, Vlad the Impaler, union, the kingdom, Ceaușescu and the revolution of 1989.

checkpoints.name: Dacia and Rome
checkpoints.note: The Dacian kingdom was conquered by Trajan in 106, and its people came to speak a Latin tongue. Migrating peoples crossed the land for centuries after Rome left.

checkpoints.name: The principalities
checkpoints.note: Wallachia and Moldavia grew up as princely states. Vlad and Stephen fought the Ottomans, under whose overlordship the lands then lived.

checkpoints.name: Romania
checkpoints.note: The two lands united in 1859 and became a kingdom. Romania won independence in 1878 and gained Transylvania after the First World War.

checkpoints.name: Communism and after
checkpoints.note: The communists took power in 1947, and Ceaușescu ruled harshly until the revolution of 1989. Romania joined NATO and the European Union.
